dev_inputs.note: Disk image with MBR; SquashFS v3 LE superblock at offset 4677120 (MBR partition 1, sector 9135).

dev_inputs.name: openwrt-brcm47xx-2.6-squashfs.trx
dev_inputs.note: TRX container (kernel + SquashFS v3 LE at offset 753664).

carved_fs.note: carved to EOF; contains 65540 trailing junk bytes after fs end (7z: Physical Size 786432, Tail Size 65540).

carved_fs.carve: dd if=openwrt-brcm47xx-2.6-squashfs.trx of=brcm47xx-rootfs.squashfs bs=1 skip=753664 count=1061809
carved_fs.note: carved exactly to filesystem size (unsquashfs -s: Filesystem size 1061809).

unsquashfs.why: gzip only for v3; these images use LZMA (OpenWrt squashfs-lzma). stderr: 'gzip uncompress failed with error code -3 ... FATAL ERROR: File system corruption detected'.

rea_runs.command: cd <run> && REA_UNBLOB_COMMAND=$HOME/.local/bin/unblob npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 extract-firmware --format json --full-output --max-depth 1 <input> <fresh outdir>
rea_runs.without_arm: child PATH stripped of /home/vgpnk/.local/bin (hides sasquatch; npx/node/7z remain reachable)

trx-img-with.note: inner SquashFS not reached at max-depth 1 (container depth consumed); published part0/part1/part2

trx-img-without.note: same as with; trx_v1 extractor does not depend on sasquatch

extract_root_prefix.note: $output = the REA --output-directory; the published path prefix is the chunk extract root from derivations[].child_path.

subject.name: input basename
subject.observed: subject.digest.sha256 == pin for both fs inputs; evidence_id null at envelope top level (raw_result.report holds the REA report)

symlink_dispositions.note: No MaliciousSymlinkRemoved diagnostic appeared on any with-sasquatch run, including absolute-target links (etc/mtab -> /proc/mounts, etc/rc.d/* -> /etc/init.d/*). Escaping symlinks are retained as unpublished entries, not removed.
